Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

```python
from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector
random.seed(17)

scene = Scene("Golden sofa sitting room")
gold = (.67,.355,.105)
seatgold = (.73,.407,.145)
pillowgold = (.79,.49,.205)
wood = (.075,.049,.034)
blackwood = (.035,.024,.018)
white = (.89,.91,.87)

scene.include("wall", box((12,.15,6), center=(0,1.65,2.8), color=(.80,.79,.745)))
scene.include("carpet", box((14,14,.12), center=(0,0,-.07), color=(.30,.285,.27)))

sofa = Asset("ochre velvet sofa")
sofa.include("lower upholstered plinth", fillet_box((3.72,1.32,.42), .065, center=(0,.38,.28), color=gold))
sofa.include("front apron", fillet_box((3.40,.22,.30), .035, center=(0,-.247,.43), color=seatgold))
sofa.include("back structure", fillet_box((3.53,.33,1.31), .075, center=(0,.91,1.00), color=gold))
for i,x in enumerate((-.82,.82)):
    sofa.include("seat cushion "+str(i), fillet_box((1.62,1.05,.29), .115, center=(x,.205,.695), color=seatgold))
    back = fillet_box((1.64,.32,.97), .085, center=(x,.823,1.235), color=seatgold)
    back.turn("x",-5)
    sofa.include("back cushion "+str(i),back)
for x in (-1.77,1.77):
    sofa.include("broad padded arm "+str(x),fillet_box((.37,1.45,1.16), .092, center=(x,.30,.66), color=gold))
    sofa.include("arm upper pad "+str(x),fillet_box((.38,1.37,.17), .075, center=(x,.29,1.18), color=seatgold))
for x in (-1.43,1.43):
    sofa.include("low foot "+str(x),box((.12,.13,.08),center=(x,.65,.045),color=(.10,.065,.035)))
pillow = fillet_box((.68,.235,.70),.10,center=(-1.16,.48,1.225),color=pillowgold)
pillow.turn(euler=(11,-12,-10))
sofa.include("loose left pillow",pillow)
pillow2=fillet_box((.63,.23,.67),.095,center=(1.24,.63,1.23),color=(.76,.46,.17))
pillow2.turn(euler=(13,8,-9))
sofa.include("right loose cushion",pillow2)
scene.include("sofa",sofa)

table = Asset("dark rectangular coffee table")
table.include("solid walnut top",box((2.73,1.12,.105),center=(.67,-1.36,.795),color=wood))
table.include("front apron",box((2.58,.065,.16),center=(.67,-1.845,.682),color=blackwood))
table.include("back apron",box((2.58,.065,.16),center=(.67,-.875,.682),color=blackwood))
for x in (-.58,1.92):
    table.include("side apron "+str(x),box((.065,.98,.16),center=(x,-1.36,.682),color=blackwood))
    for y in (-1.82,-.90):
        table.include("square leg "+str((x,y)),box((.105,.105,.735),center=(x,y,.368),color=blackwood))
scene.include("table",table)

# Two folded linen napkins, each supporting a small saucer and cup.
cup_positions=[(-.02,-1.40),(1.12,-1.45)]
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(cup_positions):
    nap=box((.62,.42,.012),center=(x+.015,y-.005,.855),color=(.60,.68,.62))
    nap.turn("z", -12 if i==0 else 9)
    scene.include("sage folded napkin "+str(i),nap)
    fold=box((.51,.325,.009),center=(x-.025,y-.025,.866),color=(.74,.77,.69))
    fold.turn("z",-12 if i==0 else 9)
    scene.include("linen fold "+str(i),fold)
    scene.include("saucer "+str(i),rod(.183,length=.016,center=(x,y,.881),color=white))
    scene.include("saucer raised center "+str(i),rod(.116,length=.014,center=(x,y,.894),color=white))
    # A polished teaspoon resting alongside each cup.
    scene.include("spoon handle "+str(i),rod(.009,start=(x+.12,y-.10,.903),end=(x+.27,y+.035,.903),color=(.52,.54,.51)))
    spoon=ball(.034,center=(x+.285,y+.049,.903),color=(.60,.62,.59))
    spoon.resize((1,.60,.15))
    scene.include("spoon bowl "+str(i),spoon)

# The flower pot has a gently tapered silhouette and fine horizontal ridges.
px,py=.60,-1.135
for j in range(34):
    t=j/33
    scene.include("planter band %02d"%j,rod(.112+.042*t,length=.010,
        center=(px,py,.854+.0087*j),color=(.075+.012*(j%2),.082+.012*(j%2),.070+.012*(j%2))))
scene.include("soil",rod(.139,length=.013,center=(px,py,1.141),color=(.055,.044,.028)))

plant=Asset("flowers and leafy stems")
clusters=[
    (-.24,.01,1.51,.095),(-.13,.06,1.65,.095),
    (.015,.045,1.77,.087),(.15,.04,1.66,.09),
    (.26,.005,1.61,.11),(.075,-.025,1.55,.077)
]
for i,(dx,dy,z,rad) in enumerate(clusters):
    top=(px+dx,py+dy,z-.035)
    plant.include("flower stem "+str(i),rod(.008,start=(px,py,1.12),end=top,color=(.22,.31,.10)))
    for j in range(37):
        a=random.random()*2*math.pi
        zz=random.uniform(-1,1)
        rr=math.sqrt(1-zz*zz)
        q=(px+dx+rad*rr*math.cos(a),py+dy+rad*rr*math.sin(a),z+rad*.80*zz)
        pet=ball(random.uniform(.014,.023),center=q,
                 color=random.choice([(.49,.57,.65),(.62,.69,.72),(.73,.77,.77),(.44,.53,.63)]))
        pet.resize((1,.8,.65))
        plant.include("tiny floret %d %d"%(i,j),pet)
for i in range(48):
    a=random.uniform(0,2*math.pi)
    r=random.uniform(.08,.29)
    z=random.uniform(1.20,1.48)
    end=(px+r*math.cos(a),py+r*.60*math.sin(a),z)
    plant.include("twig "+str(i),rod(.0035,start=(px,py,1.13),end=end,color=(.22,.31,.105)))
    for k in range(2):
        leaf=ball(.043,center=(end[0]+.026*math.cos(a+k),end[1]+.026*math.sin(a+k),z+.015*k),
                  color=random.choice([(.22,.33,.13),(.31,.42,.19),(.38,.46,.22)]))
        leaf.resize((1,.34,.19))
        leaf.turn(euler=(random.uniform(-35,35),random.uniform(-30,30),math.degrees(a)+k*60))
        plant.include("leaf %d %d"%(i,k),leaf)
scene.include("bouquet",plant)

# Bright window and the dark gray curtain at the right edge of the room.
scene.include("window glow",box((1.5,.035,3.7),center=(2.70,1.53,2.00),color=(.94,.96,.95)))
scene.include("window side trim",box((.065,.09,3.8),center=(3.40,1.47,2.00),color=(.86,.86,.81)))

realize(scene)

def lathe(name, profile, center, material, segments=64):
    vertices=[]
    for r,z in profile:
        for j in range(segments):
            a=j*2*math.pi/segments
            vertices.append((center[0]+r*math.cos(a),center[1]+r*math.sin(a),center[2]+z))
    faces=[]
    for i in range(len(profile)-1):
        for j in range(segments):
            k=(j+1)%segments
            faces.append((i*segments+j,i*segments+k,(i+1)*segments+k,(i+1)*segments+j))
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    mesh.from_pydata(vertices,[],faces)
    mesh.update()
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in mesh.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
    return obj

porcelain=bpy.data.materials.new("warm white glazed porcelain")
porcelain.diffuse_color=(*white,1)
porcelain.use_nodes=True
pbs=porcelain.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
pbs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*white,1)
pbs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.22
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(cup_positions):
    lathe("open tapered teacup "+str(i),
          [(.069,0),(.075,.012),(.096,.155),(.111,.225),(.109,.231),
           (.100,.231),(.087,.155),(.066,.021),(.0,.021)],
          (x,y,.901),porcelain)
    # Handles extend toward the outer edge of each setting.
    side=-1 if i==0 else 1
    pts=[]
    for j in range(25):
        a=math.radians(-85+170*j/24)
        pts.append((x+side*(.092+.073*math.cos(a)),y,.901+.126+.072*math.sin(a)))
    curve=bpy.data.curves.new("cup handle curve","CURVE")
    curve.dimensions="3D"
    curve.bevel_depth=.010
    curve.bevel_resolution=4
    spl=curve.splines.new("POLY")
    spl.points.add(len(pts)-1)
    for p,q in zip(spl.points,pts):p.co=(*q,1)
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new("porcelain loop handle "+str(i),curve)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.data.materials.append(porcelain)

curtainmat=bpy.data.materials.new("gray taupe curtain fabric")
curtainmat.diffuse_color=(.245,.24,.22,1)
curtainmat.use_nodes=True
cp=curtainmat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
cp.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(.245,.24,.22,1)
cp.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.91
# Drapery gathers toward the right midway down, then fans out below.
verts=[]; faces=[]
nu,nv=64,70
for j in range(nv+1):
    t=j/nv
    z=3.65-3.48*t
    gather=math.exp(-((t-.59)/.18)**2)
    left=1.79+.39*gather
    width=.70-.25*gather
    for i in range(nu+1):
        u=i/nu
        x=left+width*u
        y=1.38+.105*math.sin(u*math.pi*10+.9*t)+.035*math.sin(u*math.pi*21)
        y-=.17*gather*math.sin(u*math.pi)
        verts.append((x,y,z+.035*math.sin(u*math.pi*6)*t*t))
for j in range(nv):
    for i in range(nu):
        a=j*(nu+1)+i
        faces.append((a,a+1,a+nu+2,a+nu+1))
mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new("flowing curtain mesh")
mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces)
mesh.update()
curtain=bpy.data.objects.new("gathered floor length curtain",mesh)
bpy.context.collection.objects.link(curtain)
curtain.data.materials.append(curtainmat)
for p in mesh.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
sol=curtain.modifiers.new("cloth thickness","SOLIDIFY")
sol.thickness=.008

# Fine surface variation keeps the upholstery, carpet and wood tactile.
for mat in list(bpy.data.materials):
    if not mat.use_nodes:
        mat.use_nodes=True
    bs=mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if not bs:continue
    c=bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value
    if c[0]>.52 and .23<c[1]<.57 and c[2]<.28:
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.88
        noise=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=145
        noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=2
        bump=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.17
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.013
        mat.node_tree.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
        mat.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    elif .26<c[0]<.34 and abs(c[0]-c[1])<.055:
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=1
        noise=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=190
        bump=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.38
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.024
        mat.node_tree.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
        mat.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    elif .05<c[0]<.10 and c[1]<.065:
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.4
        tex=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=5
        tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value=3
        coord=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
        mapping=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
        mapping.operation="MULTIPLY"
        mapping.inputs[1].default_value=(2,85,12)
        mat.node_tree.links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
        mat.node_tree.links.new(mapping.outputs[0],tex.inputs["Vector"])
        bump=mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.16
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.009
        mat.node_tree.links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
        mat.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])

set_view((.22,-6.9,2.67),(.08,-.05,1.08),lens=46,sensor=36)
area_emitter((3.0,-.05,4.0),power=620,size=3.1,target=(0,-.1,.8),color=(1,.96,.88))
area_emitter((-2.2,-3.1,3.7),power=115,size=4,target=(0,0,1),color=(1,.96,.90))
world=bpy.context.scene.world
world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(.77,.80,.82,1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.27

sc=bpy.context.scene
sc.render.resolution_x=512
sc.render.resolution_y=342
sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.render.engine="CYCLES"
sc.cycles.samples=64
sc.cycles.use_denoising=True
sc.view_settings.view_transform="AgX"
sc.view_settings.look="AgX - Medium High Contrast"
sc.view_settings.exposure=.35
cam=sc.camera
cam.data.dof.use_dof=True
cam.data.dof.focus_distance=(cam.location-Vector((.5,-1.1,1.15))).length
cam.data.dof.aperture_fstop=7.0
```
